en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.subtitulo: On the databases you already use
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.resumen: Software built for one specific problem, on top of your current systems. You do not have to start from scratch to solve what no off-the-shelf product covers.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.heroTitulo: You don't have to replace everything to fix one thing
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.heroBajada: Web and mobile applications built on the databases you already have: an inventory portal, a field app, a dashboard for management. They solve the specific problem without touching what works.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.problema.t: No off-the-shelf product covers your odd case exactly

Every company has one process that does not fit: the one that gives it an edge, or the one it has dragged along forever. Forcing it into an off-the-shelf product makes it worse, and replacing the whole system over that one piece is out of proportion. What is needed is a piece built for it.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.problema.p: The process that sets you apart fits in no product
You pay for a whole system to use 20 % of it
The data is there, but nobody can query it the way they need
The field team has no way to record things on the spot
Every customer asks for their own report and someone builds it by hand
Replacing the ERP over one feature is out of proportion
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.beneficios: On top of what you already have
The application reads from and writes to your current databases. There is no migration and no second place where the data gets duplicated.
Apps you install on the phone for people who work outside: routes, clock-in, stock counts, deliveries. They work where the work is.
So they can check their statement, their order or their file without calling. Every lookup that answers itself is one call fewer.
With the numbers people actually look at, updating on their own. Predictive analytics included, when there is enough history for it.
So your systems talk to each other, and to those of your customers and suppliers, instead of through a file someone emails.
We hand over the code and the data
With its documentation. What we build is yours, and that includes being able to take it to another provider.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.cifras.0.e: it works on your current databases
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.detalles.0: We start with the smallest thing that solves it
A short first version that already works teaches more than six months of specification. What is unnecessary shows up by using it.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.detalles.1: Writing into another system's database has rules
Its validations have to be respected, or the ERP ends up with data it considers impossible itself. That is why it gets analysed first.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.detalles.2: A field app has to work with no signal
If it demands a constant connection, the technician writes on paper and types it in later — which is exactly what we were trying to avoid.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.detalles.3: The customer portal faces the outside world
People outside the company see it, so the control over what each one can see is designed first, not bolted on at the end.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.detalles.4: Without documentation it is not fully yours
Handed-over code that nobody else understands ties you down just the same. That is why it comes with its documentation and its data structure written out.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.detalles.5: Sometimes the answer is not to build it
If a module of the platform or a setting in the ERP already solves it, we say so. It is cheaper for both of us.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.pasos.0.de: How it is done today, who does it and what goes wrong.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.pasos.1.de: The smallest thing that already works, to use it and adjust it.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.pasos.2.de: What is actually asked for, not what was imagined at the start.
You have a process of your own
Your team works out in the field
And writes on paper to type it in later.
Your customers call about the same thing
And a portal would answer it on its own.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.0.preg: Do I have to replace my current system?
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.0.resp: No. We build on the databases you already use, respecting their rules.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.1.resp: Yes, installable on the phone and designed to work even when the signal drops: if they demand a connection, the technician goes back to paper.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.2.resp: Yes, with its documentation and its data structure. Handed-over code that nobody else understands ties you down just the same.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.3.resp: The short first version ships fast on purpose: it gets used, adjusted and extended with what is actually asked for.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.4.preg: What if what I need already exists?
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.4.resp: We say so. If a module of the platform or a setting in your ERP solves it, it is cheaper for both of us.
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.5.preg: What technologies do you work with?
en.serv.aplicaciones-a-la-medida.faq.5.resp: React, Node, PHP/Laravel, Python, SQL Server and MySQL, among others. The choice is dictated by the system we have to live alongside.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.subtitulo: AI applied, not AI talked about
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.resumen: Agents and models that run repetitive tasks, read documents, generate reports and connect systems. If it doesn't save someone hours, we don't call it AI.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.heroTitulo: If it doesn't save someone hours, we don't call it AI
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.heroBajada: Agents that run the repetitive work, automatic document reading, predictive models on your own sales, and connections between the systems you already have. Inside your processes, not in a demo.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.problema.titu: Almost everything sold as AI never reaches the actual work
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.problema.text: The conversation about artificial intelligence usually stops at the pilot that impresses and never goes live. The repetitive work that really costs money — keying in supplier invoices, reconciling two systems, building the same report every Monday — is still done by a person.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.problema.punt: Someone keys in by hand what arrives as a PDF
The same report is built from scratch every week
Two systems don't talk to each other and someone is the bridge
Customers get the same answer twenty times a day
The data is there, but nobody looks at it until there's a problem
The AI pilot impressed everyone and never went live
Supplier invoices and receipts that arrive as PDFs become records, with a screen to review what the reading understood before accepting it.
Connected to your systems with limited permissions, they do the whole task: they read, decide by your rules and leave the result recorded.
Demand forecasting, customer churn risk, anomaly detection. With your history, not with an example from another industry.
What moves from one program to another today because someone copies it, moves on its own. It's the dullest saving and the one that gives back the most hours.
Before building, we count how many hours that task costs today. If the number doesn't add up, we say so.
With a human where it's needed
Anything with consequences — a payment, a price, a commitment to a customer — goes through an approval. Automation is not the absence of control.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.cifras.0.etiq: the unit the result is measured in
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.cifras.1.etiq: models are trained on your own history
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.0.de: A misread document that goes in unchecked is worse than typing it: nobody ever checks it again. That's why the review step isn't optional.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.1.de: A predictor built on three months of data gives a number that looks certain. When there's no basis for it, we say so instead of delivering noise.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.2.de: An agent with permission to everything is a security risk by another name. Each one gets exactly what it needs.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.3.ti: We start with the dullest task
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.3.de: The one nobody wants to do and everybody does. That's where automation pays for itself and where the team welcomes it.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.4.ti: AI that decides leaves a trail
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.4.de: Which data it used and why it proposed that. Without it, when it gets something wrong there's no way to correct it or to defend it.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.detalles.5.de: Customer health score, attendance anomalies, demand forecasting and purchase suggestions come with the modules, not as a separate project.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.pasos.0.titul: We measure what it costs today
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.pasos.0.descr: How many hours go into that task, and whose.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.pasos.1.titul: We build the smallest thing that works
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.pasos.1.descr: On your real systems, not on a mock-up.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.pasos.2.titul: It goes live and gets measured
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.pasos.2.descr: If it didn't save what was expected, it gets adjusted or withdrawn.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.publico.0.des: That takes up hours of expensive people's time every day.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.publico.1.tit: You handle a lot of documents
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.publico.1.des: They arrive as PDFs and someone keys them in.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.publico.2.tit: You have data and don't use it
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.publico.2.des: Because looking at it costs more than deciding by eye.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.0.pregunt: Do I need to have a lot of data?
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.0.respues: To automate tasks, no. For predictive models you do need history, and if there isn't any we say so before starting.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.1.pregunt: Does it integrate with my current systems?
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.1.respues: Yes: we work on the databases and systems you already use, without requiring you to change them.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.2.pregunt: And what if the AI gets it wrong?
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.2.respues: Anything with consequences goes through human approval, and every decision leaves a record of which data it used. Without that you can neither correct it nor defend it.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.3.pregunt: How do I know it's worth it?
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.3.respues: It gets measured first: how many hours that task costs today. If the number doesn't add up, we say so instead of selling it to you.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.4.pregunt: Does any of this come with the platform?
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.4.respues: Yes: customer health score, attendance anomalies, demand forecasting and purchase suggestions already come with their modules.
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.5.pregunt: Is my data used to train third-party models?
en.serv.automatizacion-con-ia.faq.5.respues: No. The models are applied to your data for your own operation; anything shared with an outside provider, if there is any, is disclosed beforehand.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.subtitulo: So the team uses what the company paid for
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.resumen: Training on the ERP you have in place and on Artificial Intelligence tools, using your own company data and processes. Not a generic course.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.heroTitulo: Software nobody knows how to use is money sitting idle
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.heroBajada: Training on the system you have and on the AI tools you can start using tomorrow — with your own data and your own cases, not with the vendor's examples.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.problema.titul: The tool gets bought and knowing how to use it does not
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.problema.texto: The training budget is the first thing cut and the one that costs most. The system gets implemented, a two-hour talk is given, and six months later the company uses 20 % of what it paid for — while the other 80 % is still being done by hand alongside it.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.problema.punto: You use 20 % of what you paid for
The training was a two-hour talk
Only one person really knows how to use it
Generic courses do not talk about your case
The person you trained leaves and takes the knowledge with them
Support gets called for things the system already handles
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.beneficios.0.t: With your data and your cases
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.beneficios.0.d: You practise on your own operation, not on the vendor's example. What you learn that way gets used the next day.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.beneficios.1.d: Whoever invoices does not need the same as whoever does the accounts. One course for everybody bores half the room and loses the other half.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.beneficios.2.d: Specific tools applied to the real work of each area, with their limits spelled out: what they do well and where you should not trust them.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.beneficios.3.d: Having only one person who can use the system is an operational risk. The training covers the stand-in from the start.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.beneficios.4.d: For whoever joins later. Without it, every new hire repeats the whole training or learns by copying whoever sits nearby.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.beneficios.5.d: If basic queries drop after the training, it worked. It is the least arguable measure there is.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.cifras.0.etiqu: you practise on your own operation
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.cifras.1.etiqu: not the same course for everyone
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.cifras.2.etiqu: there is always a trained stand-in
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.0.tit: Training before you use it does not stick
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.0.des: Whatever gets taught without a real problem in front of you is forgotten within days. It is better to train when there is already something to solve.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.1.tit: Explaining the limits of AI is part of the course
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.1.des: A team that over-trusts a tool which is sometimes wrong produces errors that look like certainties.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.2.tit: The one who already knows it all teaches the most
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.2.des: Training whoever already masters the system so they can train the rest is what keeps the knowledge inside the company.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.3.tit: The system's built-in help gets taught too
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.3.des: Knowing that every screen explains what it does saves half the queries: plenty of people have no idea that panel is there.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.4.des: A whole day saturates. Several short sessions with real work in between stick far better.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.5.tit: We also train the ones who do not want it
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.detalles.5.des: Resistance is nearly always fear of looking bad in front of the team. A small group with no audience sorts it out.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.pasos.0.descri: The syllabus gets defined by role, not one for everybody.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.pasos.1.descri: With your data, your cases and real work between sessions.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.pasos.2.descri: The material stays, and we check whether basic queries drop.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.publico.0.desc: And the team uses only a small part of it.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.publico.1.titu: You want to get started with AI
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.publico.1.desc: And you do not know where to start or within what limits.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.publico.2.desc: And every departure takes the knowledge with it.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.0.respuest: No: it runs on your data, your processes and your cases. Whatever is learned on the vendor's example is forgotten within days.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.1.pregunta: Do you train on the ERP I already have?
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.1.respuest: Yes, whether it is ours, Softland, Profit or ODOO.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.2.pregunta: What do you teach about AI?
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.2.respuest: Tools you can apply to the real work of each area, and above all their limits: where they help and where you should not trust them.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.3.respuest: We prefer short repeated sessions, with real work in between: a whole day saturates and little sticks.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.4.respuest: Yes, for whoever joins later. Without it, every new hire repeats the training or learns by copying.
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.5.pregunta: How do you measure that it worked?
en.serv.capacitacion-ti-e-ia.faq.5.respuest: Through support: if basic queries drop after the training, it worked. It is the least arguable measure.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.resumen: Accounting and financial advice connected to your operation: processes, tax filings and analysis so you can decide with real numbers, in time.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.heroTitulo: Numbers that arrive in time to decide with them
en.serv.consultoria-contable.heroBajada: Accounting and financial advice integrated with your systems: so the month-end close does not take two months, so tax filings come out of the operation, and so the statements are good for deciding, not just for filing.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.problema.titul: Accounting that is only good for filing taxes
en.serv.consultoria-contable.problema.texto: In many companies the accounts run two months behind and exist only to satisfy the tax authority. By the time the income statement arrives, the decision that depended on it has already been made by eye — and nobody can explain why the margin fell, because the data comes aggregated and late.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.problema.punto: The month-end close arrives two months late
The statements are only good for filing
Nobody knows which product or area makes any margin
Tax filings get assembled by hand against the deadline
The accounts and the operation do not reconcile
Nobody can explain why the bottom line fell
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.0.d: If the accounts feed off the operation, closing the month means reviewing rather than re-typing. That is where the weeks are won.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.1.t: Tax filings straight from the data
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.1.d: 606, 607, 608, 609 and the IT-1 generated from what is recorded and reconciled against the statements, instead of assembled separately against the clock.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.2.t: Results by area and by product
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.2.d: With properly defined cost centres you know what makes money and what does not. A global figure only tells you something is going on.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.3.d: Receivables against their account, inventory against its own. That is the check that tells you whether the accounts describe reality.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.4.d: Margin, break-even point, cash flow and cost structure, explained in business terms rather than in accounting line items.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.beneficios.5.d: With the paperwork in order and the backup for every figure easy to find. An audit with the house in order costs half as much.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.cifras.0.etiqu: the tax filings, not by hand
en.serv.consultoria-contable.cifras.1.etiqu: the result, not just the overall one
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.0.tit: A late close is not an accounting problem
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.0.des: It is a decision problem: the numbers arrive once the decision has already been made without them. That is why we attack the re-keying, not typing speed.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.1.tit: A cost centre only measures what gets charged to it
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.1.des: If half the costs go unassigned, the result by area is a fiction. The first thing to do is measure how much is left out.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.2.tit: The 607 has to reconcile with the income statement
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.2.des: If the sales declared and the sales recorded do not match, one of the two is wrong — and both have been filed.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.3.tit: An accrual that is never reversed counts twice
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.3.des: The estimated cost is recognised and then the invoice arrives. If the accrual is not reversed, the month's result lies.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.4.tit: Tax accounting and management accounting differ
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.4.des: And that is normal. The problem is when nobody knows by how much or why: that gap has to be explainable.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.5.tit: Decide what to outsource, and decide it early
en.serv.consultoria-contable.detalles.5.des: Having the whole accounting function outside is convenient until you need a number quickly. The boundary gets set at the start.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.pasos.0.titulo: A review of what is there
en.serv.consultoria-contable.pasos.0.descri: Processes, chart of accounts, closes, and what reconciles and what does not.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.pasos.1.descri: So the journal entries come out of sales, purchases and payroll.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.pasos.2.descri: A close in days, tax filings from the data and analysis you can use.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.publico.0.desc: And you decide without the numbers.
en.serv.consultoria-contable.publico.1.desc: And the forms get put together by hand.

en.serv.consultoria-contable.faq.4.respuest: Yes, with the preparation beforehand: an audit with the paperwork in order and every figure traceable costs half as much.

en.serv.consultoria-electoral.resumen: Public perception, electoral market intelligence and trend monitoring, with the methodology stated and margins of error published.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.heroTitulo: Run the campaign on data, not on what your inner circle feels
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.heroBajada: Measurement of public perception, electoral market intelligence and trend monitoring, with the methodology and the margin of error always stated.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.problema.titu: The campaign that gets decided in the war-room meeting
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.problema.text: With no measurement, the strategy comes from what the team heard on the street and from what the people who already vote for you say. It is the most expensive bias in any campaign: you invest where you are already winning and neglect where you are losing, and you find out on election day.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.problema.punt: The strategy comes from what the war room heard
You only measure among the people already backing you
Nobody knows what moves the undecided voter
Resources go where you are already winning
You react too late to a shift in the trend
Polls get commissioned without knowing whether the sampling is sound
Sample, method, dates and margin of error, every time. A poll with no methodology sheet is not data: it is an opinion with numbers on it.
The average hides what matters. What each group thinks and what moves it is what lets you decide where to invest.
One measurement is a photograph; several are a film. The change between measurements says more than the figure in any single one.
The election is decided there, not among those who have already made up their minds. Measuring it separately is what changes the strategy.
What is being said and where, so you can react in time. A trend spotted late can no longer be corrected, only managed.
Campaign data is sensitive by definition. Handling the information is part of the service, not an annex to it.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.cifras.1.etiq: not the average, which hides things
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.0.ti: With no methodology sheet it is not a poll
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.0.de: Sample, method, dates and margin. A figure without those cannot be compared with another or defended in front of anyone.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.1.ti: The margin of error decides whether there is a gap
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.1.de: Two candidates separated by less than the margin are tied, whatever the headline says. Reading it wrong changes the strategy.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.2.ti: Measuring only among your own confirms what you already believe
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.2.de: It is the most expensive bias in a campaign, and the easiest to commit without noticing: the sample has to represent the electorate.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.3.ti: A badly worded question tilts the answer
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.3.de: You can get whatever result you want by changing how you ask. That is why the questionnaire gets reviewed and published.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.4.ti: One measurement is not a trend
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.4.de: Comparing with the previous one, using the same methodology, is the only thing that lets you say something is shifting.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.5.ti: The uncomfortable finding is the most valuable one
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.detalles.5.de: A consultancy that only delivers good news is not measuring, it is keeping you company. We report whatever comes out.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.pasos.0.descr: What you want to know, who gets asked and by what method.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.pasos.1.descr: Data collection, quality control and statistical analysis.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.pasos.2.descr: What it means for the campaign and what is worth doing about it.

en.serv.consultoria-electoral.faq.1.respues: By comparing it with the margin of error: two candidates separated by less than the margin are tied, whatever the headline says.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.faq.2.pregunt: Do you also measure perception of a term in office?
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.faq.2.respues: Yes, not just voting intention: perception of performance, of proposals and of image, by segment.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.faq.3.respues: Yes, and it is the most useful part: one measurement is a photograph, and what decides the strategy is the change between measurements made with the same methodology.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.faq.4.pregunt: And what if I do not like the result?
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.faq.4.respues: It gets reported anyway. A consultancy that only delivers good news is not measuring.
en.serv.consultoria-electoral.faq.5.respues: As part of the service and not as an annex: campaign data is sensitive by definition.
en.serv.encuestas-y-estudios-de-mercado.res: Opinion research, censuses, sampling and statistical processing for the public and private sectors, with the methodology stated and the raw data handed over.
en.serv.encuestas-y-estudios-de-mercado.her: Asking properly is harder — and cheaper — than deciding badly
Opinion research, market studies, censuses and statistical processing. With the methodology stated, the margin published and the raw data handed over.
en.serv.encuestas-y-estudios-de-mercado.pro: Decisions get made on what your existing customers say

It is the most accessible sample and the most biased: the people who already buy from you will tell you why they like what you do. The ones who did not choose you — who are the ones that explain why you are not growing — are not in that conversation, and a product or pricing decision made that way comes expensive.
You only ask the people who already buy from you
The survey is written by whoever wants a particular result
Nobody knows whether the sample represents anything
The data arrives already processed and cannot be checked
The study arrives once the decision has already been made
Nobody knows how to read a margin of error
en.serv.encuestas-y-estudios-de-mercado.ben: Who has to be asked for the result to mean anything. It is the single decision that most determines whether the study is any use.
You can get almost any result by changing how you ask. That is why the questionnaire gets reviewed and handed over with the report.
Interviews verified and fieldwork supervised. Without that, part of a data collection can be fabricated and the analysis will not catch it.
Cross-tabulations, significance and segmentation, not just percentages. What matters is usually in the cross-tab, not in the total.
We hand over the raw data

Market studies, satisfaction, workplace climate, censuses and programme evaluation, each with the rigour it demands.
en.serv.encuestas-y-estudios-de-mercado.cif: the sample, designed to be so
the data, on top of the report
en.serv.encuestas-y-estudios-de-mercado.det: The sample decides whether the study is any use
A thousand badly distributed responses are worth less than three hundred well designed ones. Size impresses; what matters is who it represents.
The order of the questions matters
What gets asked first conditions what gets answered later. It is a measurable effect, and that is why the questionnaire is ordered deliberately.
If one group responds much less, the result tilts without anyone seeing it. It gets measured and corrected, or it gets declared.
The cross-tab says more than the total
A global 60 % can hide a 90 % in one segment and a 20 % in another. The decision is usually right there.
A late study is no use
The deadline is part of the design: if it arrives after the decision, the rigour makes no difference. Better to narrow the scope and arrive on time.
Whoever withholds the data is asking for faith
With the raw data, their conclusions can be checked. Without it, you have to believe them.
en.serv.encuestas-y-estudios-de-mercado.pas: What you want to find out
The business question first; the instrument afterwards.
Sample, questionnaire, data collection and quality control.
A report with interpretation, plus the raw data.

Of customers or of your own team.

It depends on who they represent, not on the number: a thousand badly distributed are worth less than three hundred well designed.

Yes, on top of the report. Anyone who hands over conclusions alone is asking you to trust them; with the raw data they can be checked.
How do you guarantee the fieldwork is real?
With interview verification and supervision. Without quality control, part of a data collection can be fabricated and the analysis will not catch it.
Do you work with the public sector?
Yes: censuses, programme evaluation and opinion studies, with the rigour and traceability it demands.
The deadline gets set at the start, because it is part of the design: a study that arrives after the decision is no use however rigorous it is.
Yes, and that is where the value is: the total usually hides what matters, which shows up when you cross-tabulate by segment.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.subtitulo: Softland, Profit, ODOO and open-source platforms
en.serv.erp-y-crm.resumen: We deploy, customise and migrate the ERPs the Dominican market already uses. If your system is good and badly deployed, you do not need to replace it.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.heroTitulo: Your ERP is not always the problem: sometimes the problem is how it was deployed
en.serv.erp-y-crm.heroBajada: We work with Softland, Profit, ODOO and open-source platforms: deployment, customisation, version migration and rescuing projects that stalled halfway.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.titulo: The system is paid for and the company still works in Excel
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.texto: It is the most common case that reaches us: the licence is paid, the ERP installed, and the real operation lives outside it. It is almost never the software's fault — it was configured without understanding how the company works, nobody was trained, and the reports that were needed never got built.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.puntos.0: The ERP is installed and people are still on spreadsheets
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.puntos.1: The version is so old it no longer has support
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.puntos.2: Migrating is scary in case the history is lost
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.puntos.3: The reports you actually need are missing
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.puntos.4: Nobody in the company knows how to configure it
en.serv.erp-y-crm.problema.puntos.5: The original supplier no longer answers
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.0.descripcion: We have done it: from Profit 2K8 to 2K12, with zero history lost and without stopping the company. The migration is rehearsed before it is run.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.1.titulo: Deployment that starts from how you work
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.1.descripcion: First you understand how the company works; then you configure. The other way round is how you end up with an ERP nobody uses.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.2.descripcion: Crystal Reports, SQL, dashboards. The ERP has the data; often what is missing is the question asked properly.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.3.descripcion: If the previous supplier vanished, we take the system as it is and get it working, without starting from scratch.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.4.descripcion: An ERP only one person knows how to use is a risk. Training is part of the deployment, not an add-on.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.5.titulo: Integration with what you already have
en.serv.erp-y-crm.beneficios.5.descripcion: Your ERP talking to your invoicing, your bank or your online shop, instead of to a file someone exports by hand.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.cifras.0.etiqueta: platforms: Softland, Profit, ODOO and open source
en.serv.erp-y-crm.cifras.2.etiqueta: for the reports the ERP does not ship with
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.0.titulo: The migration is rehearsed on a copy
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.0.descripcion: Before touching production it is run end to end on a duplicate and the balances are reconciled. Migrating "live" is how a history gets lost.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.1.titulo: The numbers are reconciled before and after
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.1.descripcion: The same figures measured in the old system and in the new one. Without that comparison there is no way to claim the migration went well.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.2.titulo: An old unsupported version is a risk
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.2.descripcion: Not because of the features it lacks, but because the day it breaks there is nobody to call and no patch to apply.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.3.descripcion: Every change to the standard build complicates the next upgrade. It is done when the business requires it, and it is documented.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.4.titulo: The data is there, the question is not
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.4.descripcion: Most of the time the missing report can be pulled from what the ERP already stores. Before building anything, we look.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.detalles.5.descripcion: If what you have has nothing left to give, the Zyntello SaaS platform is a way out with no licences and no server of your own.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.pasos.0.descripcion: What you have, how it is configured and what actually gets used.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.pasos.1.descripcion: What gets fixed, what gets migrated and what stays. With dates.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.pasos.2.descripcion: It gets deployed, reconciled, and the team that will use it gets trained.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.publico.0.descripcion: And you are not getting half of what you paid for.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.publico.1.titulo: Your version is no longer supported
en.serv.erp-y-crm.publico.1.descripcion: And migrating is scary because of the history.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.publico.2.descripcion: And the system stayed exactly as it was.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.0.pregunta: Which ERPs do you work with?
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.0.respuesta: Softland, Profit, ODOO and open-source platforms, plus our own SaaS platform.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.1.pregunta: Can we migrate without stopping the business?
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.1.respuesta: Yes. We have done it from Profit 2K8 to 2K12 with no downtime and no history lost: the migration is rehearsed on a copy and reconciled before it is run.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.2.pregunta: What if my previous supplier is gone?
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.2.respuesta: We take the system in whatever state it is in. The assessment says what can be kept and what is better redone.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.3.pregunta: Do you build the reports that are missing?
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.3.respuesta: Yes, with Crystal Reports, SQL or dashboards. Often the data is already there and what is missing is the query.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.4.respuesta: Yes, and not as an add-on: an ERP only one person knows how to use is a risk to the company.
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.5.pregunta: Is heavy customisation a good idea?
en.serv.erp-y-crm.faq.5.respuesta: Only as much as needed. Every change to the standard build complicates the next upgrade, so it is done where the business requires it and left documented.
en.serv.marketing-digital.resumen: Search ranking, campaigns and analytics with one rule: what gets reported is what actually comes in, not how many people saw an ad.
en.serv.marketing-digital.heroBajada: Search ranking, campaigns and analytics wired into your operation, so you know which channel brings the customers who buy — not how many saw the ad.
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.titulo: The report is full of numbers that mean nothing
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.texto: Reach, impressions, engagement: metrics that go up when you spend more and that say nothing about whether a customer came in. Without connecting the campaign to the actual sale, the decision on where to invest gets made with whatever is easy to measure, not with what matters.
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.puntos.0: The report talks about reach, not about sales
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.puntos.1: Nobody knows which channel brings customers who buy
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.puntos.2: The site gets visits and generates no enquiries
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.puntos.3: The money goes to whichever channel makes the most noise
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.puntos.4: The enquiry arrives and nobody follows it up
en.serv.marketing-digital.problema.puntos.5: We do not show up when someone searches for what we sell
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.0.titu: Measured all the way to the sale
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.0.desc: The campaign connects to your CRM: which source brought the enquiry and which one ended up buying. That is the only figure that decides where to invest.
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.1.desc: So you show up when someone searches for what you sell. It is traffic you do not pay per click for, and that does not switch off when the campaign stops.
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.2.desc: You start small, you measure, and you scale only what returns. Not the other way round.
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.3.titu: The site converts, not just looks good
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.3.desc: A good-looking site that generates no enquiries is an expensive brochure. The work goes into whatever makes someone get in touch.
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.4.titu: Content that answers what they ask
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.4.desc: What your customers search for before buying. Answering it well attracts better than any ad.
en.serv.marketing-digital.beneficios.5.desc: An enquiry that arrives and nobody answers is money thrown away twice. The campaign feeds into the CRM with its source attached.
en.serv.marketing-digital.cifras.0.etiqueta: the measurement, not just to the click
en.serv.marketing-digital.cifras.1.etiqueta: which channel brings the ones who buy
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.0.titulo: Reach goes up with spending, always
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.0.descri: That is why it is the favourite metric of reports that would rather you did not look at the result. It is useful for comparing creatives, not for justifying spend.
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.1.titulo: With no CRM you cannot attribute the sale
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.1.descri: You have to be able to follow the enquiry until it buys. If the follow-up lives in the salesperson's head, the measurement stops at the click.
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.2.titulo: Search ranking is slow and lasting
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.2.descri: Paid campaigns bring traffic tomorrow and switch off when you stop; search ranking takes months and stays. It is worth doing both, knowing that.
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.3.descri: An enquiry answered within minutes converts far better than one answered the next day. It is usually the biggest room for improvement, and it is free.
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.4.titulo: A bad lead costs the same as a good one
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.4.descri: That is why we measure quality and not just quantity: a campaign that brings a hundred leads who do not buy is worse than one that brings ten.
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.5.titulo: Not every channel works for everyone
en.serv.marketing-digital.detalles.5.descri: In B2B, a social network may not bring a single customer. You test with a small budget before believing any general rule.
en.serv.marketing-digital.pasos.0.titulo: What you sell and to whom
en.serv.marketing-digital.pasos.0.descripci: And how the people who buy from you search for you today.
en.serv.marketing-digital.pasos.1.descripci: Connect the campaign to the CRM: without that, there is no attribution.
en.serv.marketing-digital.pasos.2.descripci: A small budget first; we scale what returns.
en.serv.marketing-digital.publico.0.titulo: You spend and do not know if it works
en.serv.marketing-digital.publico.0.descrip: Because the report talks about reach.
en.serv.marketing-digital.publico.1.descrip: What you sell, in your own city.
en.serv.marketing-digital.publico.2.descrip: And they get lost with no follow-up.
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.0.respuesta: The ones that reach the sale: enquiries by source and which ones bought. Reach goes up whenever you spend more, so it justifies nothing.
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.1.pregunta: Do I need to have a CRM?
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.1.respuesta: To attribute the sale, yes: you have to be able to follow the enquiry until it buys. If you do not have one, we set it up — the module is in the platform.
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.2.pregunta: How long does search ranking take?
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.2.respuesta: Months, and that is why it is combined with paid campaigns, which bring traffic tomorrow but switch off when you stop.
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.3.pregunta: What budget do you start with?
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.3.respuesta: A small one, and measured. You scale what returns, not the other way round.
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.4.pregunta: Do you work on the website too?
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.4.respuesta: Yes: a site that gets visits and generates no enquiries is an expensive brochure.
en.serv.marketing-digital.faq.5.respuesta: It depends on the channel, and you test before assuming: in B2B a social network may not bring a single customer while search ranking does.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.subtitulo: Always available, and only the right people get in
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.resumen: Cloud migration, infrastructure management and information protection. We have cut operating costs by 40 % moving from an in-house server to AWS.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.heroTitulo: Always available, and only for those who should
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.heroBajada: Cloud infrastructure migration and management, plus protection of your information: access control, verified backups and a response ready for the day something happens.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.problema.titu: The server under the desk is a risk decision nobody made
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.problema.text: Many companies run their whole operation on a machine in the office that nobody chose to put there: it just ended up staying. It has no redundancy, its backup goes to a disk in the same room, and the day it fails — or someone gets in — there is no plan. And meanwhile it costs more than the alternative.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.problema.punt: The server sits in the office, with no redundancy
The backup goes to a disk in the same room
There is no plan for the day ransomware gets in
You pay for capacity that goes unused
From an in-house server to AWS with 40 % lower operating cost and high availability. The figure comes from a real case, not from a brochure.
You pay for what you use
No buying capacity for the December peak and leaving it idle in February. Sizing is reviewed, not set once.
Each person gets into their own. «Everyone has access to everything» is not convenience: it is the most common reason an incident turns serious.
In another location, and restored to verify it. A backup in the same room protects you from neither fire nor ransomware.
A record of who accesses what
It is what lets you answer after an incident. With no log, the investigation starts and ends in guesses.
What to do, in what order and who to call. Improvising it on the day of the incident is when the worst decisions get made.

en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.cifras.2.etiq: access granted, not everyone to everything

en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.detalles.0.de: Standing up in the cloud the same idle capacity you had on your own server saves nothing. The saving comes from tuning it, and that gets reviewed regularly.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.detalles.1.de: If they are connected. That is why one copy has to sit out of reach of the network you are protecting.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.detalles.2.ti: The password is not the defence
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.detalles.2.de: The second factor is. Almost every break-in starts with a stolen credential that worked perfectly well.

en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.detalles.5.de: That is why basic security training comes with the service: spotting a phishing email prevents more incidents than any appliance you can buy.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.pasos.0.descr: What you have, what is critical and how long you can go without it.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.pasos.1.descr: Architecture, access and backup, with the migration rehearsed first.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.pasos.2.descr: Monitoring, cost tuning and access reviews.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.publico.0.tit: Your server sits in the office
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.publico.0.des: And the whole operation rests on it.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.publico.1.tit: Your backup has never been tested
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.publico.1.des: And you do not know how long it would take to be running again.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.publico.2.des: On customers, on patients or on payroll.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.0.respues: Sized well, yes: in a real case, 40 % lower operating cost. Sized badly it costs more, because you pay for idle capacity.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.1.pregunt: Which clouds do you work with?
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.1.respues: Mainly AWS, and whichever ones you already use. The choice is dictated by your case, not by a preference of ours.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.2.pregunt: And what if I get hit by ransomware?
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.2.respues: There the plan matters more than the tool: one copy out of reach of the network, and a written procedure of who to call and in what order.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.3.pregunt: Is a second factor really necessary?
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.3.respues: Yes. Almost every break-in starts with a stolen credential that worked perfectly well: the password alone is no longer a defence.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.4.pregunt: Does it include training for the team?
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.4.respues: Yes, the basics of security: spotting a phishing email prevents more incidents than any appliance you could buy.
en.serv.nube-y-ciberseguridad.faq.5.respues: Yes, and it is usually the sensible route: you start with the least critical to validate the design before moving what the operation rests on.
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.subtitulo: From support technician to systems architect
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.resumen: Placement of technology profiles: support, development, databases, infrastructure and Artificial Intelligence specialists. Assessed technically, not just on a CV.
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.heroTitul: Hiring tech talent you cannot assess is an expensive bet
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.heroBajad: We find, technically assess and place IT profiles: support, development, databases, infrastructure and AI specialists. We do know what to ask.
A bad technical hire costs months, not weeks

Whoever is hiring can rarely assess what they are hiring: the CV says what the candidate chose to write and the interview measures likeability. When the profile falls short, you find out three months in, with a project already committed and the search back to square one.
A CV does not tell you whether they can actually do it
The person interviewing does not master the subject
The profile does not fit and you find out three months in
The good ones are not looking for a job
You need someone for six months, not forever
Turnover resets the knowledge to zero
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.beneficio: Whoever assesses does the same job. A technical interview run by someone who is not technical measures the candidate's confidence, not their ability.
Support, development, databases, networks, infrastructure, systems architecture and Artificial Intelligence specialists.
If you need it for six months, hiring forever makes no sense. And the other way round: whatever holds up the operation is better off being yours.
Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica. The best profiles are hardly ever looking: you have to go and get them.
A fit with your actual environment
Knowing their craft is not enough: they have to know what you use. A strong profile from another stack takes months to become productive in yours.
The first few weeks decide whether it works. We follow the fit instead of disappearing the day they sign.
the assessment is run by someone who knows
Technical fit is not the only fit
Someone excellent at a hundred-person company can sink at a ten-person one, where you have to do everything. We look at the context.
The stack matters as much as the level
Someone very good in another technology takes months to perform in yours. If the deadline is tight, that settles it.
A single specialist is a risk
If one person is the only one who understands a system, their departure is a crisis. Plan the handover from day one.
The good ones are not looking
Posting a job advert filters for who is available, not for who is best. Strong profiles have to be sought out.
The market salary is a fact
An offer below market does not attract anyone; well above it unsettles the team already there. We say so before the search starts.
Most hires that fail do so because onboarding was handled badly, not because of the profile. That is why we stay alongside.

en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.pasos.1.d: With a hands-on test, not just an interview.
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.pasos.2.d: The first weeks get followed up, because that is when it is decided.
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.publico.0: And you have no way to assess them.

en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.publico.2: You got it wrong once already

en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.1.res: Yes, with a hands-on test and run by someone who does that same job. A technical interview by someone who is not technical measures confidence, not ability.
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.2.pre: Can it be on a project basis?
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.2.res: Yes. If you need it for six months, hiring forever makes no sense — and the reverse holds too.

en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.3.res: Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica, with remote work possible depending on the profile.
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.4.pre: What happens if it does not work out?
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.4.res: We support the onboarding precisely for that: most failures are about the initial fit, not the profile, and they can be corrected if spotted in time.
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.5.pre: Will you tell me how much I should pay?
en.serv.personal-ti-especializado.faq.5.res: Yes, before the search starts. An offer below market does not attract anyone, and well above it unsettles the team you already have.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.resumen: A 34-module ERP where you subscribe only to what you use and have it running the same day, with nothing to install and no rollout project.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.heroTitulo: The ERP that starts with the module that hurts you today
en.serv.plataforma-saas.heroBajada: 34 modules sharing a single database: you subscribe to the one you need now and add the rest when the time comes, with nothing to migrate. Multi-company, multi-currency and with your country's tax rules.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.titulo: A full ERP is a year-long project that almost nobody finishes
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.texto: The classic way to buy an ERP is to sign for everything at once, pay for a long rollout and start using it once the business has already changed. That is why so many companies stay on spreadsheets: it is not that they do not want a system, it is that the system they are offered cannot be started one piece at a time.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.puntos.0: Rolling out a full ERP is a months-long project
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.puntos.1: You pay for modules you will never use
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.puntos.2: Growing means buying another program that does not talk to the first
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.puntos.3: The same data gets typed in three places
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.puntos.4: Each company in the group ends up with its own system
en.serv.plataforma-saas.problema.puntos.5: Moving into another country means redoing the whole tax setup
en.serv.plataforma-saas.beneficios.0.descri: Invoicing, Inventory, Payroll — whichever is pressing. The rest come later on the same data, with no migration and no second project.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.beneficios.1.descri: The modules do not sync: they read the same data. That is the difference from a bundle of programs wired together with bridges.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.beneficios.2.descri: Several companies in the same group, each with its own accounting, its own numbering and its data completely separate from the rest.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.beneficios.3.descri: Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica, each with its own tax, its own receipt and its filings to the right authority.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.beneficios.4.descri: Every document in its own currency, with its rate and its exchange difference calculated on collection or payment. It is not a field: it is the whole journey.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.beneficios.5.descri: You use it from the browser, with backups and updates included. There is no server to maintain and no version to upgrade.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.cifras.0.etiqueta: modules, and you subscribe to the ones you use
en.serv.plataforma-saas.cifras.2.etiqueta: up and running, with no rollout
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.0.descripc: The modules work without it and start posting entries once it is switched on. You do not need everything on day one to start using something.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.1.descripc: Nor two subscribers'. Every query, dropdown and report is scoped by both dimensions, always. It is the promise everything else rests on.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.2.descripc: The tax register, the UN/LOCODE ports and the Ministry job codes. For you they are read-only: you never have to load or update them.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.3.titulo: Every module brings its help and its dictionary
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.3.descripc: A panel per screen, an explanation per field and the documentation of your data. You do not need a course to use a new screen.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.4.titulo: There are vertical editions, not just modules
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.4.descripc: Restaurant, Car Wash, Condominiums, Prestamello. If your business has its own way of operating, there is a vertical edition or one gets built.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.detalles.5.descripc: Per module and per plan, on this very site. You do not have to request a quote to know what you are looking at costs.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.pasos.0.descripcion: The module that solves whatever eats the most of your time today.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.pasos.1.descripcion: Country, currency, taxes and the chart of accounts of your jurisdiction.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.pasos.2.descripcion: And you add modules when you need them, on the same data.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.publico.0.descripci: And a full ERP feels like overkill.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.publico.1.descripci: And the month-end close goes into making them agree.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.publico.2.descripci: And each one demands its own tax rules.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.0.pregunta: Do I have to subscribe to every module?
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.0.respuesta: No. You subscribe to the ones you use and add the rest whenever you like, with no migration: they come in on the same data.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.1.pregunta: How long until it is up and running?
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.1.respuesta: The same day to start operating. What takes time is loading your master records, and we help with that.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.2.pregunta: Does it work for several companies?
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.2.respuesta: Yes, each with its own accounting, its own tax numbering and its data completely separate.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.3.pregunta: Which countries does it work in?
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.3.respuesta: Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica, each with its own tax, receipts and official filings.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.4.pregunta: What if my business is very particular?
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.4.respuesta: There are vertical editions for restaurants, car washes, condominiums and lending; and if yours is not there, we build it on the same platform.
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.5.pregunta: Where can I see the pricing?
en.serv.plataforma-saas.faq.5.respuesta: Published in the Platform section of this very site, module by module.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.resumen: Support for infrastructure, networks, servers and systems, with service levels agreed around how your company operates — not around a generic table.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.heroTitulo: Someone answers when something goes down
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.heroBajada: Support for infrastructure, networks, servers and workstations, with response times agreed around what each thing costs your operation when it stops.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.problema.titulo: IT only gets noticed when it fails, and by then it is too late
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.problema.texto: While everything works, nobody thinks about the server or the backup. The problem is that most outages could have been seen coming: a disk that had been warning for months, a backup that was never tested, a network built for ten people that forty now use.
When something goes down, there is nobody to call
The backup exists but nobody has tried restoring it
The network was built for half the people there are today
Nobody knows what equipment there is or what state it is in
The cost is in halting the operation, not in fixing the machine
Each incident gets fixed and nothing is recorded
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.beneficios.0.des: Response time is agreed around what each system costs your operation while it is down. A production server is not a printer.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.beneficios.1.des: A backup that was never restored is not a backup: it is an assumption. We verify that it can be recovered, how old the data will be and how long it takes.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.beneficios.2.des: LAN, WiFi, file and application servers, built for the people you have today and the ones you will have.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.beneficios.3.des: Regular checks on what warns before it breaks: disks, temperature, free space, updates. It is the cheapest thing you can do.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.beneficios.4.tit: An inventory of what you have
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.beneficios.4.des: What equipment there is, where, under which licence and in what state. Without that, every purchase decision is made blind.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.beneficios.5.des: What failed, what was done and how long it took. That is what makes the pattern visible: anything that happens three times has an underlying cause.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.cifras.1.etiquet: the backup is restored to prove it works
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.cifras.2.etiquet: every incident, so the pattern shows
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.0.titul: A backup is measured in recovery time
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.0.descr: Not in whether it exists. How long it takes to be operating again and how much work is lost are the two questions, and almost nobody has them answered.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.1.titul: Anything that happens three times has a cause
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.1.descr: That is why incidents get logged: the same failure fixed ten times costs more than fixing its origin once.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.2.titul: Office WiFi is not home WiFi
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.2.descr: Forty devices on a home router work until they do not, and the symptom looks like «the internet is slow».
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.3.titul: An unlicensed machine is a legal risk
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.3.descr: That is why the inventory includes licences: a software audit does not warn you before it arrives.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.4.descr: It is the most common way in for ransomware. Removing it costs one awkward conversation and saves a very bad month.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.detalles.5.descr: Most of it is solved remotely, and faster. What needs hands goes on site, within the time that was agreed.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.pasos.0.descripc: What there is, what state it is in and what is critical to operating.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.pasos.1.descripc: What is covered, with what response times and through which channel.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.pasos.2.descripc: Day-to-day support, plus the maintenance that prevents the outage.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.publico.0.descri: And when something breaks, you improvise.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.publico.1.descri: And it needs support for what it cannot cover.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.publico.2.titulo: You have had a long outage
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.publico.2.descri: And you do not want it to happen again.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.0.pregunta: What response times do you work with?
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.0.respuesta: Whatever is agreed around what each system costs your operation while it is down. A generic table is no use: a production server is not a printer.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.1.pregunta: Is the support remote or on site?
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.1.respuesta: Both. Most of it is solved remotely, and faster; what needs hands goes on site.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.2.respuesta: Yes, and by restoring them: a backup that was never tested is an assumption, not a backup.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.3.pregunta: Does it cover the users' computers?
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.3.respuesta: Yes, workstations as well as servers and the network, with their inventory and their licences.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.4.pregunta: Do you work outside the Dominican Republic?
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.4.respuesta: Yes: a direct presence in the Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Colombia, Guatemala and Costa Rica, and remote support for the rest of the region.
en.serv.soporte-tecnico-ti.faq.5.respuesta: They all get logged precisely so it shows: anything that happens three times has an underlying cause that is cheaper to fix.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.resumen: An assessment of what you have, a technology roadmap with priorities, and support through implementation. Consulting that stays until it works.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.heroTitulo: A roadmap someone actually executes, not a report that gets filed away
en.serv.transformacion-digital.heroBajada: An assessment of your systems and processes, priorities ordered by what each one returns, and support until it is up and running. Without the execution part, this would be just a document.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.problema.tit: The consultancy that hands over a report and leaves
en.serv.transformacion-digital.problema.tex: The pattern repeats: a firm arrives, interviews everyone, hands over a document with twenty recommendations and invoices. Six months later the document is still in a drawer because nobody had the time or the judgement to carry it out, and the company is the same with less budget.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.problema.pun: The report gets delivered and nobody acts on it
A bad process gets digitised and ends up bad but digital
Each department buys its own tool on its own
There is no way to prioritise among twenty proposals
Money goes in and nobody measures whether it helped
People go back to their old way within two months
en.serv.transformacion-digital.beneficios.0: An assessment of what is there
Systems, processes, data and who does what. Without that map, any recommendation is a hunch in good packaging.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.beneficios.1: Priorities set by what they return
Ranked by impact and effort, not by what sounds most modern. The first item has to show results soon or nobody carries on.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.beneficios.2: The process gets fixed before it gets digitised
Automating a bad process makes it faster, not better. That is the most expensive mistake in digital transformation.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.beneficios.3: An architecture that holds up as you grow
Decided once and with judgement, instead of each department buying its own tool and someone acting as the bridge afterwards.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.beneficios.4: We stay until it works. A report without execution is the most expensive way of changing nothing.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.beneficios.5: Whatever was meant to improve, measured before and after. Without that there is no way to know whether the investment paid off.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.cifras.0.eti: by impact and effort, not by fashion
en.serv.transformacion-digital.cifras.1.eti: with us alongside, not just the report
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.0.t: Digitising a bad process makes it worse
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.0.d: It gives it speed and an air of rigour. First you fix the process, then you automate it: the other way round, the mistake becomes institutional.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.1.t: The first step has to show results soon
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.1.d: If the first step takes a year to show, the organisation stops believing and the rest never happens. That is why the order matters so much.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.2.t: Change gets blocked by people, not by technology
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.2.d: Someone who has done it one way for fifteen years has reasons. If nobody listens to them, they go back to their own method within two months.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.3.t: Each department with its own tool is the problem
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.3.d: Eleven tools that do not talk to each other cost more than one that works, and the cost is not in the licences but in the human bridge.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.4.d: What works and nobody argues about gets left alone. A roadmap that touches everything is a roadmap that will not be carried out.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.5.t: With no measurement there was no transformation
en.serv.transformacion-digital.detalles.5.d: There was spending. Defining which number has to move before you start is what separates an investment from a purchase.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.pasos.0.desc: Systems, processes, data and people. What works and what does not.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.pasos.1.desc: What comes first, what comes later and what gets dropped, each with its reason.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.pasos.2.desc: It gets implemented, people get trained, and whatever was meant to improve gets measured.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.publico.0.ti: You know something has to change
en.serv.transformacion-digital.publico.0.de: And you do not know where to start.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.publico.1.ti: You have already paid for consulting
en.serv.transformacion-digital.publico.1.de: And the report is still in a drawer.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.publico.2.de: And every department has its own tool.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.0.pregun: Do you just hand over a report?
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.0.respue: No, and that is the difference: the assessment and the roadmap come with support through execution. A report without execution is the most expensive way of changing nothing.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.1.respue: With whatever shows a result soon. If the first step takes a year to show, the organisation stops believing and the rest never happens.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.2.respue: No. What works and nobody argues about gets left alone: a roadmap that touches everything is one that will not be carried out.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.3.pregun: How do I know if it worked?
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.3.respue: Because which number has to move is defined beforehand, and it is measured before and after. Without that there was spending, not transformation.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.4.pregun: And what about resistance from the team?
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.4.respue: That is the real blocker, not the technology. Someone who has done it one way for fifteen years has reasons, and if nobody listens they go back to their own method within two months.
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.5.pregun: Do you have to implement your own platform?
en.serv.transformacion-digital.faq.5.respue: No. If what you have works, we fix it; our platform is an option, not the conclusion of the assessment.
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.subtitulo: Hardware and software with the advice included
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.resumen: Import and sale of equipment, software and technology solutions. The technical advice comes with the purchase: we tell you what you actually need, even if it is less.
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.heroTitulo: Buying the right equipment costs less than buying the expensive one
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.heroBajada: Import and sale of hardware, software and solutions, with the technical advice included. What you buy has to fit what you already have and last as long as the use will.
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.titulo: People buy on price or from a catalogue, and pay twice
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.texto: Buying technology without technical judgement produces two expensive and opposite mistakes: the cheap machine that falls short within a year, and the oversized one you pay for in full to use half of. Both come to light late, when there is no returning it.
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.puntos.0: The machine falls short within a year
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.puntos.1: You pay for capacity that is never used
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.puntos.2: It is not compatible with what is already there
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.puntos.3: It arrives uninstalled and stays in its box
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.puntos.4: The warranty does not cover what you thought
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.problema.puntos.5: Software got bought that you already owned
en.serv.venta-de-equipos.beneficios.0.descr: What is actually needed for the use you will give it. Sometimes the answer is a cheaper machine, and we say so anyway.

zh-Hans.blog.conciliacion-bancaria-lo-que-nunca-: 银行对账：永远对不上的那六项
银行
银行的余额和你账上的余额本来就不必相等。要紧的是能在五分钟内解释清楚这个差额，而不是花两天。
它们不必相等，但必须说得清
第一个误解：对账单上的余额和你账上的余额本来就不该相等，碰巧相等也说明不了什么。
只要能一项一项说清楚，差额就是合理的。对账的工作不是把两个数字弄成一样，而是把差额由什么构成写下来。
每次都是那六项
已开出未兑现的支票。你这边已经扣了，银行那边还没有。几乎总是金额最大的一项。
在途存款。你已经入账，银行第二天才贷记。
手续费和各项收费。银行已经扣了，你看到对账单才知道。
银行贷记的利息和收益，没人入账。
客户直接打进来的款，事先没打招呼。在有人查出是谁的之前，它们一直挂在「未识别」里。
差错，你的或银行的。数量最少，但确实有。
八个月前开出、至今没兑的支票，不是一项对账差异：那是一个问题。要么丢了，要么供应商已经用别的方式收到钱了，要么它本来就不该存在。在对账表里越放越久的支票要去查，不是一直往下带。
怎么把两天变成半小时
对账是结账工作里最受益于自动化的一项，因为其中 90% 的行都是一目了然的匹配：
导入对账单，而不是手工敲进去。
让系统按金额、日期和参考号提出匹配，人只复核对不上的那部分。
经常对，不要等到结账。一周一次是十五分钟；一月一次是两天。
让未结项目带着账龄摆在明面上，老的自然就跳出来了。
最重要的一点：让收款和付款在系统里产生。如果一半的流水都没入账，对账就不是对账，而是补录。我们在为什么收到的钱跟银行对不上里讲过这件事。
几分钟完成对账
Zyntello 的银行模块导入对账单、提出匹配，并把未结项目连同账龄摆在明面上。
zh-Hans.blog.flujo-de-caja-proyectado-no-es-el-s: 现金流预测：知道将来有多少，而不是现在有多少
资金管理
今天的余额决定不了任何事。真正决定的是 25 号会有多少钱——那天要发工资，大供应商的货款也到期。
有钱和能花，不是一回事
看银行余额，回答的是一个没多大用的问题：现在有多少。真正起决定作用的问题是另一个：到了我必须付钱的那天，会有多少？
盈利的公司经常没现金，而且几乎从来不是因为没有毛利：是日期对不上。你 60 天收回来，30 天就得付出去，中间还夹着一次发薪。
预测的数据从哪来
好消息是，几乎所有数据都已经存在，只是分散着：
你要收的钱：未结发票及其到期日。按那个客户实际上通常拖多久来调整，而不是按合同约定的。
你要付的钱：未结的供应商发票及其到期日。
已承诺但未开票的：已批准、即将到货的采购订单。
周期性的：工资、租金、水电、税款。最容易预测，分量也最重。
如果这些都在同一套系统里，预测就是一次查询。如果散在四个地方，那就是一张有人每周重做、当天就过期的 Excel。
让它真正有用的，是贴近现实
一份假设所有人都按期付款的预测没有用。它在设计上就是乐观的，所以没人信它。
按每个客户的实际行为来调整。如果某个客户约定 60 天却总是 75 天才付，就按 75 天预测。
把确定的和可能的分开。一张来自不接电话客户的逾期发票不是一笔收入，那是一个指望。
看几种情景。如果那个大客户晚两周会怎样。正是这一点，把预测变成了决策工具。
价值不在于把数字算准，而在于提前三周看见那个缺口。有三周，可以去谈一个账期或者提前收一笔款。只有三天，就只能去借贵钱。
在掉进缺口之前先看见它

zh-Hans.blog.antiguedad-de-saldos-lo-que-no-dice: 账龄分析表：那份报表没告诉你的事
收款
应收账款里用得最多的那张报表，也是最会骗人的。它藏起来的三件事，决定你收不收得到钱。
人人都在看的那张报表
账龄分析表把别人欠你的钱分成几档：未到期、30、60、90、90 天以上。它是全世界用得最多的收款报表，读对了确实有用。
问题在于，大家把它当成「谁会付钱给你」来读，而它说的不是这个。它说的是每张发票拖了多久没付，这不是一回事。
它藏起来的三件事
一个账面正常、问题却很大的客户。如果他每个月都准时付，但一个季度里总余额涨了 40%，账龄表什么都不标：全都是「未到期」。敞口变大了，报表却不说。
「不付」和「有争议」的区别。落在 90 天档里的一张发票，可能是客户不付钱，也可能是客户因为交货问题拒收。两者的处理方式完全不同，而报表把它们放在一起。
约定的账期。如果你给了某个客户 60 天，他那张 45 天的发票并没有逾期，哪怕它落在一个看着吓人的档里。按开票日而不是按到期日算的账龄，会无缘无故吓你一跳——更糟的是：在不该安心的时候让你安心。
账龄要按**到期日**算，不是按开票日。这是最常见的错误，它产出的报表看着没问题，但对每一个不是现款交易的客户来说都是错的。
除此之外还该看什么
每个客户余额的趋势，而不只是余额本身。在涨是早期信号；逾期是晚期信号。
实际的平均收款天数和约定的天数对比。如果约定 30 天而实际 52 天收到，你就是在给客户提供 22 天的融资——而这是没人决定过的。
你的余额里有多少集中在少数客户身上。一张总体健康的报表，可能掩盖着 60% 都是一个客户欠的。
哪些发票在争议中，标出来，带上原因。打电话去催一张三周前客户就拒收的发票，是把时间浪费两遍。
真正决定你收不收得到钱的事，发生在更早
不太好听的结论：等一张发票出现在 90 天档里的时候，真正重要的决定早就做完了。你给了谁信用额度、给了多少、什么账期，以及事先有没有查过。
这要靠信用额度来管，问题是在那里被挡住的。账龄分析表是体温计；信用额度才是治疗。
提前收回来，而不是事后追
Zyntello 的应收账款模块按真实到期日计算账龄，标出争议发票，并在到期前就提醒。
zh-Hans.blog.limite-de-credito-que-hace-y-que-no: 信用额度：它管什么、不管什么，以及为什么几乎总被绕过
客户信用
一个可以悄无声息绕过去的额度，不是额度。怎么设置才有用，又不挡住正当的生意。
它真正的用处
信用额度不是为了说「不」。它是为了在超过某个数字时逼一个人做决定，而不是让敞口在没人察觉的情况下一直长。
这就是有用的额度和装饰性额度的区别：有用的那个会打断。如果系统提醒了却照样放行，而且没人去看那些提醒，这个额度就等于不存在。
实际中是怎么被绕过的
从我们实施这套东西看到的，绕过去的办法总是那几种：
换个途径开票。手工发票、另一个门店、集团里的另一家公司。
把额度「临时」调高，然后没人调回去。半年之后，额度就是一部超限史。
额度没把未交货订单算进去。客户已经用到额度的 90%，还有三笔待交货的订单会把它顶破。系统放行了，因为那些还不是发票。
比的是今天的余额，不是逾期的部分。一个客户可以既在额度之内，又全部逾期：数字说可以，现实说不行。
能看出你的额度管不管用的检查：去查上个季度有多少笔销售是超额批准的，以及是谁批的。如果答不上来，你没有额度，你只有一个字段。
怎么设置才不会挡住生意
另一边的风险也是真的：控制得太死，每笔销售都变成一道手续，最后干脆被关掉。有效的做法：
审批要快，而且要留痕。一个负责人，用手机，一分钟搞定——并且留下谁批了什么的记录。
拦截要区分原因。超额和有逾期发票不是一回事。后者更严重，应该更早就拦住。
要算上全部承诺额：已开票的，加上还没交货的订单。
额度要用数据来复核。连续两年准时付款的客户值得更高的额度；开始拖延的那个，该降。
还有一个比看上去更重要的实现细节：额度只能存在一个字段里。我们见过系统里有两个从不同年代遗留下来的信用额度字段，一个用来显示，另一个用来校验。结果就是一个看起来在生效、实际上没有的控制。
一个真的会拦住的额度
在 Zyntello 里，额度把已开票和订单都算进去，区分超额和逾期，审批会留下是谁批的记录。
zh-Hans.blog.recibo-de-cobro-por-que-no-cuadra-c: 为什么收到的钱，从来对不上进银行的钱
收款
月度收据总额和银行存款对不上的五个原因。没有一个是算错账。
差额总是有解释的
月结了，你把收到的钱加起来，跟进账户的钱一比。对不上。而且因为差得不多，就很想调一下了事。
这个差额几乎从来不是算错。是五个具体原因，每一个的处理方式都不一样。
五个原因
支票收了但没存进去，或者存了但还没入账。收据有了，钱还没有。在银行贷记之前，那笔钱是在途的，就得按在途来显示。
银行手续费。客户付了 10,000，进来的是 9,970。这个差额不是部分收款：它是一笔费用，要进它自己的科目。
客户的代扣税。在好几个国家，客户会扣下一个百分比，并给你一张凭证。如果不按代扣入账，看起来就像他少付了钱，发票上会留下一个永远没人去收的余额。
汇兑差额。你按一个汇率开票，按另一个汇率收款。这个差额是一项损益，不是对不上账。我们在毛利是在哪里流失的里讲过。
进了银行却没有收据的一笔钱。某个客户没打招呼就转了账。钱在那里，没人知道对应哪张发票：最后挂成一笔越放越久的未识别款。
共同的套路
把这五个放在一起看，规律就出来了：每一个里面都有一笔确实存在、却没有按它本来的性质入账的金额。手续费被记成部分收款，代扣税被当成欠款，汇兑差额被塞进了收入。
而且它们最后都表现为同一个症状：发票上留着永远结不掉的小额余额，客户以为自己付清了，而你的系统说他还欠 30。
这些极小的余额比看上去贵得多：它们污染账龄分析表，让催收的人去追根本不存在的金额，最后还被核销成坏账——而它们从来就不是债。
系统应该做什么
把「收到」和「存入」分开，让在途资金摆在明面上。
把手续费、代扣税和汇兑差额各自作为独立项目入账，各进各的科目。
当所有这些项目之和覆盖了金额时就结清发票，而不是只看收到的现金。
设一个未识别收款的收件箱，让没有归属的进账看得见，而不是被稀释掉。
让收到的和存入的自己对上
Zyntello 把收款和存款分开，把手续费和代扣税按它们本来的性质入账，并在收款时计算汇兑差额。
zh-Hans.blog.orden-recepcion-factura-los-tres-do: 订单、入库单和发票：几乎没人去比对的三份单据
采购控制
多付钱是因为没人把「订了什么」「到了什么」「开了多少票」放在一起比。这是三方比对，而它总在同一个地方失守。
三个时点、三份单据、三个数字
一笔采购要经过三个时点，每个时点都会产生自己的单据和自己的数字：
你订了什么——采购订单：约定的数量和价格。
到了什么——入库单：真正进仓库的东西。
收你多少钱——供应商的发票。
三者一致时，付钱不用多想。控制就在于：三者不一致的地方，一分钱都不付。听着理所当然；几乎没人做到。
它总是在哪里失守
有意思的是，问题几乎从来不出在发票上。出在中间那一环：
收货时不跟订单比对。仓库只记到了什么，不看是不是订的那个。如果 100 件只到了 95 件，这个差要几周后才冒出来。
按订的开票，不是按到的开票。供应商按整张订单开票，没人拿它去跟部分入库单核对。
发票上的价格不是订单上的价格。一次没人批准的涨价，而且因为发票已经批了，就照付了。
没有订单就收了货。最棘手的情形：来了一批没人正式订过的东西，现在得决定付不付。
退货给供应商是最被忽视的一环：货退回去了，如果没和对应的贷项通知单挂上，最后你会为一件已经不在手里的东西付整张发票。
容差，才是让这套控制真能用起来的东西
一个为了一分钱就拦下来的控制，一周之内就会被关掉。所以需要容差，而定这些容差本身就是工作的一部分：
散装商品有一点数量差是正常的；设备就不是。
价格差在约定幅度之内可以放行；超过了，就走审批。
最重要的是：超出容差的东西不会被默默拦下。它会送到某个具体的人那里，由他署名决定。
除了不多付钱，还能得到什么
在发票到之前就知道自己欠多少。已收货未开票的部分是一笔真实的负债，如果没入账，负债就是不完整的。
存货成本在收货时形成，不是在开票时——而收货时正是它应该形成的时刻。
用数据来衡量供应商：他真正要多久，有多少次交货不齐。这会喂给再订货点。
只为订了并且到了的东西付钱

zh-Hans.blog.retenciones-a-proveedores-que-descu: 对供应商的代扣：让供应商账户对不上的那笔扣款
付款
代扣扣错了不会报错：它会让供应商来追一笔你以为已经付清的余额。为什么会这样，以及怎么从供应商档案上把它堵住。
它是什么，以及为什么会对不上
付钱给某些供应商时，并不是把全款交出去：有一部分被扣下，以他们的名义缴给税务机关。你要给供应商一张代扣凭证。
对不上的情况出现在：代扣被记成了一笔少付的款。于是发票上留着一个根本不欠的余额，供应商来追，最后要么有人付了两遍，要么那个余额永远挂在那里。
代扣并不减少你欠供应商的钱：它只是把这笔钱转给了税务机关。发票是全额结清的，一部分用现金，一部分用代扣。如果系统里没有这个概念，就根本没办法正确记录。
人人都会出错的地方
扣了不该扣的人。比例和是否该扣，取决于供应商类型和服务类型。凭习惯去套，碰到新情形就会错。
用错了比例。比例不止一个：按项目性质而变。
算错了计算基数。按含税总额算，而本该按另一个基数算，或者反过来。
没开凭证。供应商需要这份单据才能抵扣被扣的部分。没有它，这就既是他的问题，也是你的问题。
没进到申报表里。扣下来的要申报。如果它只活在发票上、不在申报表里，申报的时候就缺了。
要在供应商那里修，不是在付款那里修
和606、607 报表一样，修的地方不是问题出现的地方：
供应商的类型和适用税制，在建档时定一次。
服务类型写在单据上，扣什么由它推出来。
系统给出代扣建议；人只确认，不计算。
凭证随付款一起开出，不是作为一道要靠人记得的额外手续。
申报表由已登记的代扣生成，不是来自一份并行的表格。
比例、计算基数和哪些类型的供应商需要代扣，由各国法规规定，并且会更新。请与你的会计师或主管机关确认现行规定。
扣对了，就没有幽灵余额
